utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what parts of the repair drive still need help?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A few things still need hands — tools, spare parts, and someone to help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — which of those do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can bring by a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’m a little scattered, but I think we still need a hammer and some screwdrivers. I’ll double-check and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll set aside a hammer and a few screwdrivers for you. Just give me a shout if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been hearing that the repair drive is really picking up—lots of folks are pitching in already. If you want, I can keep an eye out for the latest updates and tell you what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and whether I need to drop anything off before it gets crowded.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check on that for you—if I hear the drop-off window or any crowding, I’ll let you know right away. Folks are saying it may get busy later, so sooner might be easier.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring a wrench set and a few spare screwdrivers to the community shed? If you can, also check the west side of the repair tent for any loose boxes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring the wrench set and spare screwdrivers to the community shed, and I’ll check the west side of the repair tent for loose boxes too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please—put me on it. Thanks for thinking of me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—you're on the list now. I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. I’ll share the sign-up and supply list as soon as I have it ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Send it over when it’s ready and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Leo — I’m finishing the sign-up and supply list now, and I’ll send it your way shortly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Check the sign-up sheet first, and then we can see which tools or supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the sign-up sheet first, then I’ll note which tools and supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around school drop-off and pickup times, so let me know when the repair drive needs me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s really kind of you, Faye — I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive schedule and match you to drop-off or pickup time if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, that works for me — just send me the times and I’ll do my best to fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a little about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — folks are signing up, and we’re just trying to match people with the right fixes. If you want, I can catch you up on the biggest needs so far.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please — I’d love the quick version on what people need most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still good to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still good to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey. Could you bring a pair of work gloves and maybe a hammer if you’ve got one?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can bring both. I’ll see you there with the gloves and hammer.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone updated on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell folks what’s needed and keep everyone posted as the repair drive comes together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to ask if you need a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I could use a hand sorting donations and loading a few boxes. I’ll let you know when I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, just give me a shout when you’re ready and I’ll come over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a little behind on the details, but I can help if you remind me what’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks—it's the same repair drive, just moving ahead with the latest fixes. I’ll send the updated details so you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—send me the updated details and I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a quick list, and you can bring whatever tools you already have.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send the list my way, and I’ll bring what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Mara — could you help me spread the word and maybe bring a few tools if you have them? I’ll send along the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Quinn — I’ll spread the word and I’ll see what tools I can bring. Send me the details when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—do you want me to share details with both friend groups?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please share it with both friend groups — the more folks who know, the better.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll let both groups know and encourage them to come by. The more hands we have, the better the repair drive will go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and I’ll make sure everyone knows the plan. If you’ve got anything to add, I’m ready to note it down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a small box of screws and a couple rolls of tape I can add. I’ll drop them off with you this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you. I’ll be here this afternoon and I’ll log it in with the rest of the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’ve got a decent list now, but we still need more volunteers for the Saturday shifts. Are you able to help for an hour or two?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can probably help for an hour or two on Saturday. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t caught the details yet—when’s the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s this Saturday morning at the school lot, and if you can bring a few hand tools and some gloves, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a few hand tools and gloves this Saturday morning at the school lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still okay bringing a few tools for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still bringing a few tools for the repair drive.
